name: Burnstate
summary: Mac menu-bar app that puts every AI coding limit (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and others) against the clock, so you know when you would run dry hours before it happens.
description: Mac menu-bar app that puts every AI coding limit (Claude Code, Codex, Cursor and others) against the clock, so you know when you would run dry hours before it happens.

pricing.details: Subscription from 4 € a month, or 23 € a year (48% less than monthly, official; activate on 1 Mac, cancel anytime, keep what you paid for). One-time license with updates included — 45 € for 1 Mac, 63 € for 2 Macs, 81 € for 3 Macs. Sold via Creem (receipt and VAT). Also listed as coming soon on the Mac App Store; Setapp membership is a separate official option with Setapp’s own 7-day trial.
